title: The High-Flying Solarian Stomp
idea: In the sun-drenched coastal boomtown of Solaria, tough-talking, tap-dancing cable-mechanic Buster 'Speedy' Sparks operates the city's lightning-fast solar tram. With the grand autumn festival arriving on October twenty-seventh, Buster wagers everything on a high-stakes musical derby to prove his sun-powered cars can climb to the highest peaks. But when his rival's sabotage knocks out the central altitude governor, Buster and his brass-blaring crew must dance across the runaway tracks, desperately trying to divine whether their golden car will soar upward or plunge below.
visual: A bustling, sun-baked cliffside harbor bathed in deep amber and warm sepia tones, where rugged, smiling mechanics leap along gleaming teal and purple elevated rails suspended high above crashing waves. Dynamic shadows and swirling autumnal dust frame energetic performers mid-stride with gleaming brass horns under a roaring midday sky.
